meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 这个技能会让Claude引导你创建一个持久的wiki知识库，包括建立目录结构、容器技能和组配置，并严格按照文件逐个处理来源。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”、“wiki”、“knowledge base”、“llm wiki”或“karpathy wiki”时触发。

say.note: 触发技能，开始设置步骤。

say.text: 我要建立关于机器学习的wiki。
say.note: 技能会与你讨论领域和来源。

howto.what_en: This skill guides you through creating a persistent wiki knowledge base in NanoClaw, including directory setup, container skill, and group configuration, processing sources one at a time.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", or "karpathy wiki".

say_en.text: Help me add a wiki knowledge base.
I want to create a wiki about machine learning.
say_en.note: Skill will discuss domain and sources.

say_en.text: Start setting up Karpathy LLM Wiki.
